scope: Independent source, lexical-evidence and semantic-fidelity review of four exact Amharic short tool captions; no application changes.

decisions.rationale: The components and rectangular image-area meaning are supported. The new method/shape construction is not itself attested. The evidence does not settle whether the geometry phrase plus በ- and selector head is an idiomatic tool caption, rather than selection by or of a geometric object. No demonstrated mistranslation is asserted; do not replace it with another unvalidated composition merely to remove a hold.
decisions.resolution: Validate the whole caption with an Amharic reviewer in the rectangular image-area selection context, or obtain a stronger primary whole-caption precedent. Preserve distinction from drawing a rectangle.

decisions.rationale: The glossary component denotes drawn freeform geometry, not freeware or free price. The proposed composition plausibly names selecting by that outline, but source attestation for the complete selection caption and its naturalness are absent. A line-creation caption would change the operation and is not an acceptable substitute.
decisions.resolution: Validate the complete area-selection caption, explicitly distinguishing a freehand closed selection boundary from a freeform line drawing tool.

decisions.rationale: The exact phrase is a Fill Color precedent, not a Bucket fill precedent. Colour filling is a real part of the target action, so this is not an unrelated or proven false rendering. However, it generalizes a specific flood-fill tool into a label also supported for an object area-colour control. Omitting the bucket metaphor is not automatically wrong, and a short caption need not spell out contiguity or tolerance. The actual unresolved question is whether the phrase is a natural functional equivalent identifying this tool, including as a standalone accessible name, rather than a fill-colour setting. The supplied evidence does not establish that transfer.

additional_source.finding: Official LibreOffice Help identifies Fill Color as setting the area colour of the selected object, confirming that the attested source action is not the target raster flood-fill tool.
additional_source.limit: Context corroboration only, not new Amharic lexical support.

decisions.resolution: Obtain a validated idiomatic bucket/flood-fill caption or validate this functional equivalent specifically against colour and shape-fill controls. Do not silently relabel English as Fill Color. If the product intentionally changes the English term, correct English first and flag affected translations across languages.

decisions.rationale: Retain for this bounded short-caption review. This is an exact non-fuzzy Pipette caption in a primary software translation source, and the adjacent control help specifically instructs clicking a colour in an image. That is a close match to the relevant sampling action, unlike borrowing the containing Color Replacer dialog label. The English Eyedropper is itself a physical-tool metaphor; the possibility of a literal drop-measurement reading is not by itself evidence of a mistranslation. Moving the sampled value into foreground rather than a replacement-source colour box changes downstream use, not the sampling-tool metaphor. The second Pipette context corroborates spelling only, because its actual operation selects matching-colour bitmap parts. It is not counted as independent evidence for foreground sampling.
decisions.resolution: No replacement is required by this source/semantic review. Prefer this attested sampling-control term over an unvalidated descriptive composition. Keep native-reader preference, rendering and larger composed strings as separate unperformed checks.

context_corrections.finding: Every selectTool call executes applyPending, and applyPending unconditionally calls finishSelection. Therefore choosing a selection tool, switching between selection tools, or reselecting the current tool can commit a floating selection. Do not describe commitment as restricted to leaving selection tools.
context_corrections.classification: Review-context precision correction; not an English-caption defect.

context_corrections.finding: The sampled pixel is assigned through the foreground setter, which forces opaque alpha. The caption needs no alpha explanation, but the behavior record must not promise preservation of sampled transparency.
context_corrections.classification: Additional precision; no claim that the original draft promised alpha preservation.

behavior_verified.rectangle: Sorted drag bounds are intersected with the bitmap, extents below one unit are rejected, integer crop bounds are produced and pixels copied. An existing floating selection may commit first; later movement/resizing/rotation can erase and redraw source pixels.
behavior_verified.free_form: The trace records pointer motion, adds the final pointer-up point, closes the path, computes bounds and clips copied pixels by the path. It creates an area selection, not a drawn freeform line.
behavior_verified.fill: The foreground fills the seed-connected region. Horizontal scanline runs and immediately adjacent rows give four-neighbour connectivity. Matching is against the original seed, using exact colour equality at zero threshold or squared RGBA distance against tolerance.toInt() squared. The UI slider is not a percentage-of-image specification.
behavior_verified.eyedropper: A bounds-checked pointer-up samples one bitmap pixel using integer coordinates and assigns foreground. No neighbourhood averaging or background target is used. Recent colours/UI/autosave update afterward; tool choice can already have committed a floating selection.

fidelity_policy: Translate the current English meanings. No English defect has been established. A translation-evidence gap is not permission to change English; an intentional English change would require explicit source correction and cross-language affected-term tracking.
limits: Source-only review, not a native-speaker or modern-usage certification.
No build, runtime, rendering, accessibility speech or UI-fit validation.
No exhaustive fresh repository consumer scan. Supplied complete files were byte-verified and relevant call chains inspected.
No Work task, production change, CI, release or remote write.
GIMP fuzzy/empty records provide no Amharic acceptance evidence.
All LibreOffice files form one translation ecosystem, not multiple independent linguistic authorities.
Full glossary PDF, rendered pages and page text remain local-only; this output includes bounded terms, metadata, summaries and source links only.
No full third-party PO file is included in this independent output.
Prior 90 ready / 14 adjudicated holds remain unchanged; this is a separate 1-retain / 3-hold independent recommendation for parent adjudication.
